strategies.title: Strategy Control
strategies.disposition: Phase 1 remains preserved with final result APPROVED_SPACE_EXHAUSTED / RESEARCH_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED. Phase 2 routes 1 and 2 remain terminally implementation-inconclusive with no economic result. Route 3, volatility-managed equal-weight v2, used all three substantive no-data direction-review attempts and never reached a frozen preregistration, implementation, backtest, or formal economic evaluation. A fresh live read-only Sol/xhigh terminal audit independently confirmed PREREGISTRATION_BLOCKED_DIRECTION_REVIEW_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED / METHODOLOGY_INCONCLUSIVE / NO_ECONOMIC_RESULT. This is not unprofitability, HISTORICAL_NO_GO, DATA_NO_GO, or economic consumption of the family. Route 4, Binance archive PTU acquisition v3, is selected next but has no route authorization, preregistration, network action, or data acquisition yet. Controller tests and contract evidence are not evidence of trading profitability. Every Phase 2 final holdout remains closed and unread, no candidate is promoted, capital remains zero, GPU permission remains zero, and Vertcoin mining is unchanged.
